subject: Error while conducting calibration for monthly data

messages.author: b2b5d143566e32dd
messages.subject: Error while conducting calibration for monthly data
parts:
Hi Tam

Congratulation on developing R-SWAT.

I have worked with your example data, and it seems to run without problem However, I have problem while trying to calibrate my monthly river flow time series. For this purpose, I applied your UserReadSwatOutput file and changed it for my data. Based on my File.cio, my model has 36 years of simulated data beginning from 1979. I want to apply the data from 1981 (as there is two year of warm-up period) to 1990 for calibration at first. To make the problem simple, I only used one gaging station out of 128 subbasins and changed the date between 1981-1-1 to 1990-12-31 both in UserReadSwatOutput and model (select date range). Every time I run the model it executes 36 years of simulation (e.g. dose not care about my requested date range) and finally gives the following error:

Warning: Error in data.frame: arguments imply differing number of rows: 3652, 438

Your help is greatly appreciated.

Best

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Error while conducting calibration for monthly data
parts:
Hi, could you share with me (either here or in private message) your output file + observed data (something like obs_var_1.txt) + UserReadSwatOutput  files
changing the period for output extraction (either in the select date range or UserReadSWATOutput) does not affect the simulation period. In this case, you have to change in the file.cio to change to number of years that the model should run
